title: Astral experience on 'the hill' after Zoom call with a Telepathy Tapes guest, linked through Ken from Baker Victory
summary: Jordan Jos tells of Astral experience on 'the hill' after Zoom call with a Telepathy Tapes guest, linked through Ken from Baker Victory, about an unknown time at Astral setting ('the hill'); Baker Victory, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: they were showing me an image of um, a kid named Ken that was in the program that I was in at Baker Victory who was a non-verbal autistic

plain: A man named Jordan Jos, who says he was taken into a secret program as a child, describes a video call with someone who had appeared in The Telepathy Tapes, a documentary series about children said to read minds. Afterward, he says, he had an out-of-body experience in a place called "the hill," where he was shown an image of Ken, a non-verbal autistic boy who was in the same program with him at a place called Baker Victory. He tells it because it would link his childhood program to these mind-reading children.
